title: Variables
story: A variable is a labelled box. You write name=value with no spaces, and read it back with a dollar sign.
goal: Set a variable city to Chennai, then print: I live in Chennai
starter: # Make a variable, then use it in echo

tests.label: reads the variable instead of typing the city twice

hints: No spaces around the equals sign: city=Chennai.
Read the variable with $city inside double quotes.
socratic: What breaks if you write city = Chennai with spaces?
Why use double quotes around the sentence?
What would single quotes print instead?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Variables”?
